name: 07650 · Palisades Pk, NJ
findings: ZIP 07650 (Palisades Pk) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07650 (Palisades Pk) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
